fields.label: Enable managed e-mail
fields.description: Lets teams turn on Managed e-mail per site: the site's default outgoing Email Account "Nexaploy Relay" is pointed at this relay.

fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
Generic SMTP
Amazon SES
Postmark
Mailgun
Brevo

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Amazon SES region, e.g. eu-west-1 (default us-east-1).

fields.label: Username
fields.description: SMTP user (SES SMTP credentials, Postmark server token, Mailgun SMTP login, Brevo login). Empty = no authentication.

fields.label: Verify SMTP login on each site
fields.description: Frappe logs in to the relay when the Email Account is saved; a wrong password fails the job.

fields.label: Default from-domain
fields.description: Sender domain for sites without a verified custom domain (noreply@<domain>). Empty = the site's own name. It must be authenticated (SPF/DKIM) with the provider.

fields.label: Per-site daily send limit
fields.description: 0 = unlimited. Written to each site's config as nexaploy_email_daily_limit; enforce it at the relay (Frappe core has no daily limit).

fields.label: Domain authentication (custom sending domains)
fields.description: Records shown to customers for their own sending domain. {domain} is replaced by the customer's domain.

fields.label: SPF include
fields.description: e.g. include:amazonses.com. Empty = the provider default.

fields.label: DKIM selector
fields.description: e.g. mail, k1, pm, or the token the provider shows.

fields.label: DKIM value
fields.description: Public key (TXT, v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...) or CNAME target, e.g. {domain_dashed}.dkim.example.net.

fields.label: Return-Path host
fields.description: Label under the customer domain, e.g. pm-bounces. Empty = the provider default.
